title: They are PURPLE! Not blue! Poor quality too!
text:
They are PURPLE! Not blue! Poor quality too!. They are PURPLE. NOT BLUE!!
Also, poor quality!
Glue showing everywhere. Petals not covering Styrofoam! Save your $.

April 1, 2021 update. Still covered in glue but I needed them. If you have patience to pick glue out with tweezers, they are nice after an hour or two.
